about: Vijaya Diagnostics Centre limited is a leading diagnostic medicare services provider in Southern India and offers comprehensive services that include nuclear medicine, radiology, laboratory, health check-ups and medical services. The company provides its services across 13 cities through its 81 diagnostic centers and 11 reference laboratories. [1]
